nodes.label: Poultry Fecal Mobile Data-Collection App
nodes.rationale: Three-panel figure: two ODK/form-style Android screens flanking a field photograph of an enumerator photographing chickens with a smartphone. The app is a single scrolling form (clipboard icon, save and finalise actions in the app bar) that couples image capture, a mutually exclusive disease label, free-text observations and a GPS fix into one submitted record. The design decision is to have the annotation happen in the field at capture time rather than in a later desk-based labelling pass.

nodes.label: Fecal Image Capture (Take Picture / Choose Image)
nodes.rationale: Offering both live capture and gallery selection lets the same form serve fresh field collection and retrospective upload.

nodes.label: Disease Class Radio Selection (Healthy, Coccidiosis, Newcastle, Salmonella, Other)
nodes.source_location: left and right panels, Type of Image section
nodes.rationale: Radio buttons enforce a single mutually exclusive label per image, which is exactly the target format for supervised single-label classification; 'Other' is the escape hatch that prevents forced mislabelling.

nodes.label: GPS Reading / Start GeoPoint
nodes.rationale: Geotagging every sample enables spatial outbreak mapping and prevents duplicate/farm-confounded records; the 'please wait until phone gets reading' hint acknowledges GPS lock latency in the field.

nodes.label: In-Field Labelled Dataset Collection Strategy
nodes.rationale: Using a smartphone form as the acquisition instrument trades image quality control (variable lighting, backgrounds, handheld framing) for scale, low cost and expert-at-source labels. The centre photograph documents the realistic, cluttered capture conditions the resulting model must tolerate.
